description.narrative: Helios Towers is Africa’s leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, operating towers on over 14,000 sites and serving more than 144 million people across the continent. It operates in nine countries including Tanzania, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ghana, the Republic of the Congo (Congo Brazzaville), South Africa, Senegal, Madagascar and Malawi. Partial exit through stock sale on the London Stock Exchange.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom
